question: Which of the following festivals is celebrated in honour of Hidimba Devi in Himachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Doongri Festival**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Doongri celebration is coordinated on the propitious event of Basant Panchami.
 
• It is likewise famously known as the Hadimba Devi Fair.
 
• The celebration goes on for three days.
 
• It is coordinated at the Hadimba Sanctuary, arranged in the holy Dhungri Timberland in Manali.
